intent: Clear the five smaller python_pkg packages under the 250-line cap, leaving only wsg_grabber's test modules.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: android_ui/driver.py needed two cuts and a class split. The UiElement dataclass, the three error types and the XML parser moved to _elements.py; the text-entry and keyboard methods became a TextEntryMixin in _text_entry.py. The mixin shape is the one docs/python-split-recipes.md settled on: an ABC declaring _run, dump and wait_for as abstract, because test_driver.py calls the moved methods as bound attributes of a real driver, so module-level functions would not have worked.
AndroidUi stays in driver.py and driver re-imports the moved names, so android_ui/__init__.py's public re-exports are untouched.
app_icons/glyphs.py: the twelve SVG path fragments moved to _glyph_art.py, leaving the dataclass, registry and lookup. Pure data with no patch targets.

The four remaining test modules were partitioned at topic boundaries with a splitter that copies the whole preamble - docstring, imports and local fixture builders - and lets ruff prune what each half does not use.

verification.command: timeout 120 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/<pkg>/tests -q, for each of the five
verification.evidence: token_audit 81, focus_policy 137, random_jpg 14, app_icons 44, android_ui 57 - each identical to its baseline measured before any edit.

verification.command: timeout 120 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/android_ui/tests -q (intermediate runs)
verification.evidence: Three intermediate failures, all module-level globals that travelled with their code and were not in my hand-written header: _logger (used by the moved XML parser), then re and _SAME_FIELD_X_TOLERANCE_PX (used by the mixin). Same class of miss as _make_verifier and _QUESTIONS earlier - a def or constant between sections, which ruff cannot flag.
No output - all five packages are entirely under the cap.

verification.command: pre-commit run --files <the touched files and artifacts>
verification.evidence: ruff E402 and pylint C0413 on glyphs.py: I had placed the new import after the dataclass rather than in the import block. Moved; the gate then passed with ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and pytest-with-coverage all clean.

risks: TextEntryMixin declares wait_for with the concrete class's exact signature (timeout default 15.0). A future change to AndroidUi.wait_for that does not update the abstract declaration would pass tests but mislead type checkers and readers.
driver.py imports from both _elements and _text_entry, and _text_entry imports from _elements. That order must hold; _elements must never import from driver.
rollback: git revert the commit; the five packages return to their previous file sizes and the six new modules disappear.
After rollback, re-run each package's suite and confirm the same five counts.
